title: Rank Words by Count
statement:
Count how many times each word appears in a list, then rank the words from most common to least common.

The first line is the number of words `n`, at least 1. The second line holds the `n` words, in lowercase letters, separated by spaces. Print each different word once with the number of times it appears, as `word count`, one per line. Put the most common word first. Words with the same count go in alphabetical order.

Input:

```text
8
the cat saw the dog and the cat
```

Expected output:

```text
the 3
cat 2
and 1
dog 1
saw 1
```
